title: Daande Deƴƴunde e nder Suudu nduu
intro: Duwaawu ina 6eydoo 6ooyde e dee/re suudu ceniindu nduu ko ɓooyi, ina ummoo e 6ernde mawnde ina yidi ko aduna oo haali wonde waawaa. Ndeeɗoo limoore, yahrude yeeso e duuɓi, teeŋtunde e kulhuli ko fayti e ko fayi arde, ruttitii e Joomiraawo maɓɓe e duwaawu keeriiɗo. Ko rewi heen ko jaabawol Alla ngol luutndii kala ko ina ɗaminaa e tagoore ndee – seedantaagal yurmeende jaabtiiɗo noddaango ngo alaa ɗo haaɗi.
clues: Mi noddii Joomiraacfo am e nder suudu, mi 6uuccii suudu ndu mi 6uuccii hoore am e dewal makko.
Mi jaɓii e Joomiraawo am wonde miɗo hula ngam arooɓe caggal am, miɗo sunii e ardaade leñol am so mi yaltii.
Mawnugol ina he6i mi—kosam am ina 6eydoo 6uu6de, 6uu6ol danewol ina yaaji e hoore am.
Jom suudu am ina wonnoo jom suudu nguurndam mum fof, kono haa jooni miɗo ñaagii Joomiraawo am nde rokkata mi ronooɓe e yeeso mum.
Mi ñaagii maande, Joomiraawo am jaabiima, haɗi mi haaldude e hay gooto jammaaji tati, tawi miɗo heddii e ɓanndu am.
Mi fodaniino ɓiɗɗo gorko mo innde mum woni Yahya, innde nde Joomiraawo am habri nde meeɗaa rokkeede hay gooto.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Duwaade ronooɓe e mawngu e jom suudu mo alaa jibinannde
Wontude liɗɗi mawɗi e nder niɓɓere
Muñde majjude galle, jawdi, e cellal
trial.answer: Duwaade ronooɓe e mawngu e jom suudu mo alaa jibinannde

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Hokki ɓiɗɗo gorko inniraaɗo kaawisaaji hay so mawni no feewi
Hisnaama e yiite ngulnge e yamiroore Alla
Artiraaɗo e galle, jawdi, e cellal caggal muñal
Firaawna e konu mum njolii e nder maayo
outcome.answer: Hokki ɓiɗɗo gorko inniraaɗo kaawisaaji hay so mawni no feewi

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
